\section*{Multiple Choice (4 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item Which of the following is not a characteristic of \duallayerbox{totalitarian societies}{democratic nations}?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item indoctrination and propaganda
    \item freedom of movement for citizens
    \item one-party rule
    \item a centrally planned economy
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following best describes the practice of placing the blame for \duallayerbox{the problems of a society}{societal changes} on one particular group?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Ethnocentrism
    \item Stereotyping
    \item Scapegoating
    \item Institutionalization
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (16 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False and justify briefly.}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Scott (1991)}{Mills (1956)} introduced the term 'power elite' to describe:' is 'a state elite whose members are drawn overwhelmingly from a power bloc'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Stone's research}{Smith's findings} suggests that prior to industrialization, the nuclear family:' is 'had begun to emerge through the separation of work and home life'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Dahrendorf, Rex, and Habermas}{Weber and Durkheim} focused their attention on:' is 'the interpretive understanding of action'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Marxist feminists}{Liberal feminists} explain patriarchy in terms of:' is 'women's domestic labour being exploited by the capitalist economy'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Butler \textbackslash{}\& Stokes (1969)}{Johnson \textbackslash{}\& Smith (1980)} suggested that working class support for the Labour Party arose from:' is 'socialization into working class families and communities'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Mulholland (1998)}{Anderson (2005)} argued that privatization changed the relationship between companies and managers in that:' is 'employment depended on performance rather than trust and commitment'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Sociology}{Anthropology} can be considered a social science because:' is 'all of the above'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{White-collar crime}{Cybercrime} is low in visibility because:' is 'the police turn a blind eye to corporate crime'.
\end{enumerate}
